s: Durable execution runtime: business flows survive crashes/redeploys, replaying deterministically with retries and timers.
w: Workflow code records every decision to event history; workers replay history deterministically to resume state after failures - no state DB needed by app code. Activities (side-effecting steps) retry per policy with heartbeats; timers persist for days-long waits; signals inject external events; queries inspect state live. Version pinning handles code upgrades mid-flight.
use: Order fulfillment sagas spanning payment/inventory/shipping with compensations
KYC/onboarding approvals lasting days with human steps
Media pipelines with long-running transcodes + callbacks
avoid: Massive parallel fan-outs (millions of concurrent workflows have limits)

pat.d: Compensation activities undo prior steps on failure - code reads linearly!

pits: Non-deterministic code changes break replays - versioning discipline (pinning/pipelining)
History bloat on chatty loops - continue-as-new patterns
tips: 'Code-as-workflow' vs YAML-DAG contrast explains the durability magic crisply
